productLoss: Web rendered the canonical Server environment section with a stacked icon, Could not scan the server environment title, typed error description, and Scan action. Lynx rendered only a Source Control heading, raw error string, and Scan action.

The Lynx error section was 160px tall instead of 396px, shifting Text generation from y=532 to y=296. The shared empty-state projection and Lynx anatomy recover the canonical content and exact 896x396 section plus 896x352 empty surface.
Full-frame SSIM improves from 0.831678 to 0.864727; Settings-main SSIM improves from 0.830602 to 0.874760; error-section SSIM improves from 0.814889 to 0.895093.
harnessMismatch: The original Browser gate required only equal error strings and Scan labels, so the 236px layout collapse still passed. A pure geometry helper now rejects the old frame and requires canonical titles, empty surface, and section geometry.

The first Native verifier attempt navigated before connector commands were ready and observed the startup error not connected. The verifier now waits on a real discoverSourceControl RPC until the injected typed error arrives.

The second Native attempt compared a Browser absolute y coordinate with Native coordinates. The corrected verifier requires the same 896x396 section, 896x352 empty surface, and 48px relative section gap inside the Native coordinate space.
classification.ledgerScope: Matched Browser evidence updates Lynx content, geometry, material, and runtime. Exact-bundle Native evidence updates content, geometry, interaction, and runtime. Native material parity is not claimed.
